##### Project general facts

Casa Canal by AHS Properties is an exclusive collection of luxury residences on the Dubai Water Canal, designed around the idea of villas in the sky. The building offers penthouses, sky villas, sky mansions and a sky palace, with expansive layouts, soaring ceilings, private pools, generous terraces and elegant double-height spaces. Living areas are set along the waterfront to capture sweeping views of the canal and the Downtown skyline through floor-to-ceiling curved glass windows.

Residents enjoy a wide range of private and shared amenities centred on comfort, wellness and hospitality. These include a spa and wellness centre, a traditional hammam, a beauty centre, a gym, a yoga room and an indoor pool with pool lounge. Social spaces include a residents' lounge, a breakfast and café lounge, a screening room, a cigar lounge and a sushi omakase counter. A round-the-clock concierge, a concierge app, chauffeur and housekeeping services complete the offer.

Every home is finished with a strong focus on elegance, space and natural light. Bathrooms include his-and-her vanities, oversized travertine showers and sculptural freestanding tubs, while hand-crafted walk-in closets, show and wet kitchens fitted with appliances, private pools and jacuzzis add exceptional comfort. Private elevators open directly into the living rooms, and enclosed parking, electric vehicle charging, bicycle storage and private storage add everyday convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

The Dubai Water Canal area connects Business Bay with the coast, creating a waterfront district of promenades, pedestrian bridges, hotels and upscale residences. Safa Park lies right next to the canal, offering landscaped lawns, walking paths and open green space in the heart of the city. The area combines a calm waterside atmosphere with immediate access to Dubai's most prestigious neighbourhoods.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect the district with Downtown Dubai, the Dubai International Financial Centre, Burj Al Arab and Mall of the Emirates, all within a short drive. Dubai International Airport is easily reached, while City Walk, Jumeirah and the beaches offer dining, shopping and leisure close to home.

The Dubai Water Canal is one of the city's most sought-after addresses for ultra-luxury living, with limited supply of large-format residences. Its central position between Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Jumeirah supports strong demand from high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants. Freehold ownership and a scarcity of comparable waterfront homes underpin long-term value.
